d49.8.pinyinNumbered: jin1 tian1 shi4 xing1 qi1 liu4 ta1 zhou1 mo4 bu4 gong1 zuo4
d49.8.en: Today is Saturday, and she does not work on the weekend.

d49.9.speaker: 李
d49.9.zh: 你女朋友叫什么名字？我认识她吗？
d49.9.pinyin: Nǐ nǚ péng you jiào shén me míng zi? Wǒ rèn shi tā ma?

d49.9.en: What is your girlfriend’s name? Do I know her?

alts.pinyinNumbered: wo3 ren4 bu4 ren4 shi5 ta1

d49.10.speaker: 高
d49.10.zh: 她也姓李，她的名字叫李贵美。
d49.10.en: Her last name is also Li; and her full name is
d49.10.why: 李 is not a word in the checked lists

d49.11.speaker: 李
d49.11.zh: 什么？李贵美是你女朋友？！我认识她，我们是好朋友。她还请谁？
d49.11.en: What? Guimei Li is your girlfriend?! I know her. We are good friends. Who else has she invited?
d49.11.why: 李 is not a word in the checked lists

d49.12.speaker: 高
d49.12.en: (Besides me,) she has invited seven or eight classmates.
d49.12.why: 还 has more than one reading (hai2, huan2)

d49.13.speaker: 李

d49.13.en: Why would she not invite me?

d49.14.speaker: 高
d49.14.pinyin: Nǐ wèn wǒ, wǒ wèn shéi? Zài jiàn.
d49.14.pinyinNumbered: ni3 wen4 wo3 wo3 wen4 shei2 zai4 jian4

d50.1.speaker: 男
d50.1.zh: 你喜欢看外国电影还是中国电影？
d50.1.pinyin: Nǐ xǐ huan kàn wài guó diàn yǐng hái shi zhōng guó diàn yǐng?
d50.1.pinyinNumbered: ni3 xi3 huan5 kan4 wai4 guo2 dian4 ying3 hai2 shi5 zhong1 guo2 dian4 ying3
d50.1.en: Do you like (to see) foreign movies or Chinese movies?

d50.2.speaker: 女
d50.2.zh: 我都喜欢，可是我很忙，所以不常看电影。
d50.2.pinyin: Wǒ dōu xǐ huan, kě shì wǒ hěn máng, suǒ yǐ bù cháng kàn diàn yǐng.
d50.2.pinyinNumbered: wo3 dou1 xi3 huan5 ke3 shi4 wo3 hen3 mang2 suo3 yi3 bu4 chang2 kan4 dian4 ying3
d50.2.en: I like both, but I am busy, so I don’t often see movies.

d50.3.speaker: 男
d50.3.zh: 这个周末有一个外国电影，这个电影很好看，我们去看，怎么样？我请客。
d50.3.pinyin: Zhè gè zhōu mò yǒu yī gè wài guó diàn yǐng, zhè gè diàn yǐng hěn hǎo kàn, wǒ men qù kàn, zěn me yàng? Wǒ qǐng kè.
d50.3.pinyinNumbered: zhe4 ge4 zhou1 mo4 you3 yi1 ge4 wai4 guo2 dian4 ying3 zhe4 ge4 dian4 ying3 hen3 hao3 kan4 wo3 men5 qu4 kan4 zen3 me5 yang4 wo3 qing3 ke4
d50.3.en: There is a foreign movie this weekend. This movie is good. How about if we go see it? It will be my treat.

d50.4.speaker: 女
d50.4.zh: 是吗？谢谢。星期六还是星期天？是哪国电影？
d50.4.pinyin: Shì ma? Xiè xie. Xīng qī liù hái shi xīng qī tiān? Shì nǎ guó diàn yǐng?
d50.4.pinyinNumbered: shi4 ma5 xie4 xie5 xing1 qi1 liu4 hai2 shi5 xing1 qi1 tian1 shi4 na3 guo2 dian4 ying3
d50.4.en: Is that so? Thank you. Saturday or Sunday? What country movie is it?

d50.5.speaker: 男
d50.5.zh: 星期六晚上。是一个日本电影。
d50.5.pinyin: Xīng qī liù wǎn shang. Shì yī gè rì běn diàn yǐng.
d50.5.pinyinNumbered: xing1 qi1 liu4 wan3 shang5 shi4 yi1 ge4 ri4 ben3 dian4 ying3

d50.6.speaker: 女
d50.6.zh: Ah! 太好了！我这个星期六没有事，我也很爱看日本电影。我们几点见？
d50.6.en: Ah! Great! I am free this Saturday; also, I love (to see) Japanese movies very much. What time shall we meet?

d50.7.speaker: 男
d50.7.zh: 六点半，怎么样？我去你家。
d50.7.pinyin: Liù diǎn bàn, zěn me yàng? Wǒ qù nǐ jiā.
d50.7.pinyinNumbered: liu4 dian3 ban4 zen3 me5 yang4 wo3 qu4 ni3 jia1
d50.7.en: How about 6:30? I will go to your house.

d51.1.speaker: 王
d51.1.pinyin: Nǐ zhōu mò cháng zuò shén me?
d51.1.pinyinNumbered: ni3 zhou1 mo4 chang2 zuo4 shen2 me5
d51.1.en: What do you often do on weekends?

d51.2.speaker: 谢
d51.2.zh: 我有的时候工作，有的时候看书。
d51.2.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu de shí hou gōng zuò, yǒu de shí hou kàn shū.
d51.2.pinyinNumbered: wo3 you3 de5 shi2 hou5 gong1 zuo4 you3 de5 shi2 hou5 kan4 shu1

alts.zh: 有的时候工作，有的时候看书。
alts.pinyin: Yǒu de shí hou gōng zuò, yǒu de shí hou kàn shū.
alts.pinyinNumbered: you3 de5 shi2 hou5 gong1 zuo4 you3 de5 shi2 hou5 kan4 shu1

d51.3.speaker: 王
d51.3.zh: 你周末也工作吗？你不看电视吗？
d51.3.pinyin: Nǐ zhōu mò yě gōng zuò ma? Nǐ bù kàn diàn shì ma?
d51.3.pinyinNumbered: ni3 zhou1 mo4 ye3 gong1 zuo4 ma5 ni3 bu4 kan4 dian4 shi4 ma5
d51.3.en: Do you work on weekends as well? Don’t you watch TV?
d51.3.why: simplified and traditional differ: 你周末也工作吗？你不看电视吗？ / 你週末也工作嗎吗？你不看電視嗎？

d51.4.speaker: 谢
d51.4.zh: 我家没有电视。我的工作很忙，所以我常常没有周末。你呢？你周末喜欢做什么？
d51.4.pinyin: Wǒ jiā méi yǒu diàn shì. Wǒ de gōng zuò hěn máng, suǒ yǐ wǒ cháng cháng méi yǒu zhōu mò. Nǐ ne? Nǐ zhōu mò xǐ huan zuò shén me?
d51.4.pinyinNumbered: wo3 jia1 mei2 you3 dian4 shi4 wo3 de5 gong1 zuo4 hen3 mang2 suo3 yi3 wo3 chang2 chang2 mei2 you3 zhou1 mo4 ni3 ne5 ni3 zhou1 mo4 xi3 huan5 zuo4 shen2 me5
d51.4.en: There is no TV at my house. My work is busy. So I frequently don’t have weekends. What about you? What do you like to do on weekends?

d51.5.speaker: 王
d51.5.zh: 我喜欢做饭，所以周末我常请朋友去我女朋友家吃饭。
d51.5.pinyin: Wǒ xǐ huan zuò fàn, suǒ yǐ zhōu mò wǒ cháng qǐng péng you qù wǒ nǚ péng you jiā chī fàn.
d51.5.pinyinNumbered: wo3 xi3 huan5 zuo4 fan4 suo3 yi3 zhou1 mo4 wo3 chang2 qing3 peng2 you5 qu4 wo3 nü3 peng2 you5 jia1 chi1 fan4
d51.5.en: I enjoy cooking, so I often invite friends to my girlfriend’s house for dinner on weekends.

d51.6.speaker: 谢
d51.6.zh: 你为什么请朋友去你女朋友家？
d51.6.pinyin: Nǐ wèi shén me qǐng péng you qù nǐ nǚ péng you jiā?
d51.6.pinyinNumbered: ni3 wei4 shen2 me5 qing3 peng2 you5 qu4 ni3 nü3 peng2 you5 jia1
d51.6.en: Why do you invite them to your girlfriend’s house?

d51.7.speaker: 王
d51.7.zh: 因为她家很大。我做饭，他们打球、跳舞、听音乐。
d51.7.pinyin: Yīn wèi tā jiā hěn dà. Wǒ zuò fàn, tā men dǎ qiú, tiào wǔ, tīng yīn yuè.
d51.7.pinyinNumbered: yin1 wei4 ta1 jia1 hen3 da4 wo3 zuo4 fan4 ta1 men5 da3 qiu2 tiao4 wu3 ting1 yin1 yue4
d51.7.en: Because her house is big. I cook, and they play tennis, dance, and listen to music.

d51.8.speaker: 谢
d51.8.zh: 你的朋友都很喜欢你，对不对？
d51.8.pinyin: Nǐ de péng you dōu hěn xǐ huan nǐ, duì bù duì?
d51.8.pinyinNumbered: ni3 de5 peng2 you5 dou1 hen3 xi3 huan5 ni3 dui4 bu4 dui4
d51.8.en: All your friends like you very much, right?

d52.1.speaker: A
d52.1.zh: Wow! 你家好大！你家有几个人？
d52.1.en: Wow! Your house is so (very) big! How many people are there in your family?

d52.2.speaker: B
d52.2.zh: 是吗？我觉得我家不太大。我家有三个人。
d52.2.pinyin: Shì ma? Wǒ jué de wǒ jiā bù tài dà. Wǒ jiā yǒu sān gè rén.
d52.2.pinyinNumbered: shi4 ma5 wo3 jue2 de5 wo3 jia1 bu4 tai4 da4 wo3 jia1 you3 san1 ge4 ren2
d52.2.en: Is that so? I feel that my house is not very big. There are three people in my family.

d52.3.speaker: A
d52.3.zh: 只有三个人？你爸妈做什么工作？
d52.3.pinyin: Zhǐ yǒu sān gè rén? Nǐ bà mā zuò shén me gōng zuò?
d52.3.pinyinNumbered: zhi3 you3 san1 ge4 ren2 ni3 ba4 ma1 zuo4 shen2 me5 gong1 zuo4
d52.3.en: There are only three people? What (line of) work do your parents do?

d52.4.speaker: B
d52.4.zh: 我爸爸是医生，我妈妈是纽约大学的老师。
d52.4.en: My dad is a doctor; and my mom is a professor (teacher) at
d52.4.why: 纽 is not a word in the checked lists

d52.5.speaker: A
d52.5.zh: 你妈妈在国外吗？那你家有你、你爸爸，还有谁？
d52.5.pinyin: Nǐ mā ma zài guó wài ma? Nà nǐ jiā yǒu nǐ, nǐ bà ba, hái yǒu shéi?
d52.5.pinyinNumbered: ni3 ma1 ma5 zai4 guo2 wai4 ma5 na4 ni3 jia1 you3 ni3 ni3 ba4 ba5 hai2 you3 shei2
d52.5.en: Your mom is abroad? Then your family has you, your dad and who else?

alts.zh: 你妈妈在国外？那你家有你、你爸爸，还有谁？

alts.pinyinNumbered: ni3 ma1 ma5 zai4 guo2 wai4 na4 ni3 jia1 you3 ni3 ni3 ba4 ba5 hai2 you3 shei2

d52.6.speaker: B
d52.6.en: (Besides me and my dad,) there is my younger sister.

d52.7.speaker: A
d52.7.zh: 是吗？她多大？好看不好看？
d52.7.pinyin: Shì ma? Tā duō dà? Hǎo kàn bù hǎo kàn?
d52.7.pinyinNumbered: shi4 ma5 ta1 duo1 da4 hao3 kan4 bu4 hao3 kan4
d52.7.en: Is that so? How old is she? Is she pretty?

alts.zh: 是吗？她多大？好不好看？
alts.pinyin: Shì ma? Tā duō dà? Hǎo bù hǎo kàn?
alts.pinyinNumbered: shi4 ma5 ta1 duo1 da4 hao3 bu4 hao3 kan4

d52.8.speaker: B
d52.8.zh: 我是她哥哥，我觉得她很好看。
d52.8.pinyin: Wǒ shì tā gē ge, wǒ jué de tā hěn hǎo kàn.
d52.8.pinyinNumbered: wo3 shi4 ta1 ge1 ge5 wo3 jue2 de5 ta1 hen3 hao3 kan4
d52.8.en: I am her brother; I think she is pretty.

d52.9.speaker: A
d52.9.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu méi yǒu tā de zhào piàn?
d52.9.pinyinNumbered: ni3 you3 mei2 you3 ta1 de5 zhao4 pian4

d52.10.speaker: B
d52.10.zh: 有，可是我现在只有一张。你看，这是她的照片。她十九岁。
d52.10.pinyin: Yǒu, kě shì wǒ xiàn zài zhǐ yǒu yī zhāng. Nǐ kàn, zhè shì tā de zhào piàn. Tā shí jiǔ suì.
d52.10.pinyinNumbered: you3 ke3 shi4 wo3 xian4 zai4 zhi3 you3 yi1 zhang1 ni3 kan4 zhe4 shi4 ta1 de5 zhao4 pian4 ta1 shi2 jiu3 sui4
d52.10.en: Yes, I do, but I have only one right now. Look, this is her photo. She is 19.

d52.11.speaker: A
d52.11.zh: Wow，你妹妹好美。她有没有男朋友？
d52.11.en: Wow, your sister is so beautiful. Does she have a boyfriend?

d52.12.speaker: B
d52.12.zh: 我想她还没有男朋友，她太忙了。你问这个做什么？
d52.12.en: I don’t think she has a boyfriend yet. She is too busy (to date). But why did you ask this?
d52.12.why: 还 has more than one reading (hai2, huan2)

d52.13.speaker: A
d52.13.zh: 因為我也还没有女朋友，所以我很想认识她。她周末也很忙吗？
d52.13.en: Because I don’t have a girlfriend yet, either, I would very much like to meet (to get to know) her. Is she busy on the weekends as well?

d52.14.speaker: B
d52.14.zh: 对，她有的时候周末也很忙。可是这星期六是她生日，那天我想请她去吃饭。
d52.14.pinyin: Duì, tā yǒu de shí hou zhōu mò yě hěn máng. Kě shì zhè xīng qī liù shì tā shēng rì, nà tiān wǒ xiǎng qǐng tā qù chī fàn.
d52.14.pinyinNumbered: dui4 ta1 you3 de5 shi2 hou5 zhou1 mo4 ye3 hen3 mang2 ke3 shi4 zhe4 xing1 qi1 liu4 shi4 ta1 sheng1 ri4 na4 tian1 wo3 xiang3 qing3 ta1 qu4 chi1 fan4
d52.14.en: Yes, she is sometimes busy on the weekend as well. But this Saturday is her birthday. I am planning to take her to eat that day.

alts.zh: 对，她有时候周末也很忙。可是这星期六是她生日，那天我想请她去吃饭。

d52.15.pinyinNumbered: ni3 ba4 ba5 ye3 qu4 ma5

d52.16.speaker: B
d52.16.zh: 我爸爸这星期不在家，他去纽约看我妈妈。
d52.16.en: My dad is not home this week; he went to NY to see my mom.
d52.16.why: 纽 is not a word in the checked lists

d52.17.speaker: A
d52.17.zh: 那星期六我请你和你妹妹吃晚饭，好不好？你妹妹喜欢吃中国菜还是美国菜？
d52.17.pinyin: Nà xīng qī liù wǒ qǐng nǐ hé nǐ mèi mei chī wǎn fàn, hǎo bù hǎo? Nǐ mèi mei xǐ huan chī zhōng guó cài hái shi měi guó cài?

d52.17.en: Then I will take you and your sister to have dinner on Saturday, OK? Does your sister like Chinese food or American food?

d52.19.speaker: A
d52.19.zh: 为什么？你不喜欢吃美国菜吗？
d52.19.pinyin: Wèi shén me? Nǐ bù xǐ huan chī měi guó cài ma?
d52.19.pinyinNumbered: wei4 shen2 me5 ni3 bu4 xi3 huan5 chi1 mei3 guo2 cai4 ma5
d52.19.en: Why? You don’t like American food?

d52.20.speaker: B
d52.20.zh: 对，因为我觉得美国菜不好吃。可是因为我妈妈不在家，没有人做中国菜，所以我妹妹和我常吃美国菜。
d52.20.en: No, I don’t because I think American food does not taste good (not delicious). But because my mom is not home, and nobody cooks Chinese food, (so) my sister and I have been eating a lot of American food. (“To eat a lot” is “to eat frequently” in Chinese.)
d52.20.why: it can be split into words in two ways that read differently

d52.21.speaker: A
d52.21.zh: 可是我不想吃中国菜，我这两个星期常吃中国菜。我们吃日本菜，你觉得怎么样？我很爱吃日本菜。
d52.21.pinyin: Kě shì wǒ bù xiǎng chī zhōng guó cài, wǒ zhè liǎng gè xīng qī cháng chī zhōng guó cài. Wǒ men chī rì běn cài, nǐ jué de zěn me yàng? Wǒ hěn ài chī rì běn cài.
d52.21.pinyinNumbered: ke3 shi4 wo3 bu4 xiang3 chi1 zhong1 guo2 cai4 wo3 zhe4 liang3 ge4 xing1 qi1 chang2 chi1 zhong1 guo2 cai4 wo3 men5 chi1 ri4 ben3 cai4 ni3 jue2 de5 zen3 me5 yang4 wo3 hen3 ai4 chi1 ri4 ben3 cai4
d52.21.en: But I don’t feel like eating Chinese. I have eaten a lot of Chinese these two weeks. Let’s eat Japanese; what do you think? (Chinese people say “how do you feel about it?”) I love to eat Japanese food very much.

alts.zh: 可是我不想吃中国菜，我这两星期常吃中国菜。我们吃日本菜，你觉得怎么样？我很爱吃日本菜。
alts.pinyin: Kě shì wǒ bù xiǎng chī zhōng guó cài, wǒ zhè liǎng xīng qī cháng chī zhōng guó cài. Wǒ men chī rì běn cài, nǐ jué de zěn me yàng? Wǒ hěn ài chī rì běn cài.

d52.22.speaker: B
d52.22.zh: 太好了！我妹妹和我也都很爱吃日本菜。
d52.22.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Wǒ mèi mei hé wǒ yě dōu hěn ài chī rì běn cài.

d52.22.en: Great! Both my sister and I love Japanese food very much, too.

d53.3.zh: 有。日本啤酒、中国啤酒，我们都有。
d53.3.pinyin: Yǒu. Rì běn pí jiǔ, zhōng guó pí jiǔ, wǒ men dōu yǒu.

d53.3.en: Yes, we do. We have both Japanese beers and Chinese beers.

d56.19.en: No, I don’t. Why don’t you go with your girlfriend.

d56.21.en: Sure. What time will you be here (= What time will you come)?

d56.22.speaker: B
d56.22.pinyin: Nǐ yào wǒ men jǐ diǎn lái?
d56.22.pinyinNumbered: ni3 yao4 wo3 men5 ji3 dian3 lai2
d56.22.en: What time do you want us to come?

d56.23.speaker: A
d56.23.pinyin: Nǐ men sì diǎn bàn lái ba!
d56.23.pinyinNumbered: ni3 men5 si4 dian3 ban4 lai2 ba5

d56.24.speaker: B
d56.24.zh: 四点半？没问题！…… Mmm，大中，我女朋友认识一个漂亮的女孩，她很想认识你。她可以不可以和我们一起来？
d56.24.en: 4:30? No problem! ….. Mmm, Dazhong, my girlfriend knows a pretty girl, and she wants to meet you. Can she come (together) with us?

d56.25.speaker: A
d56.25.zh: 你要给我介绍女朋友吗？
d56.25.pinyin: Nǐ yào gěi wǒ jiè shào nǚ péng you ma?
d56.25.pinyinNumbered: ni3 yao4 gei3 wo3 jie4 shao4 nü3 peng2 you5 ma5
d56.25.en: Are you going to set me up with a girl (= introduce a girlfriend to me )?

d56.26.speaker: B
d56.26.en: That’s right! This Miss Li is pretty.
d56.26.why: 李 is not a word in the checked lists

d56.27.speaker: A
d56.27.zh: 太好了！星期六下午四点半在我家见。
d56.27.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Xīng qī liù xià wǔ sì diǎn bàn zài wǒ jiā jiàn.
d56.27.pinyinNumbered: tai4 hao3 le5 xing1 qi1 liu4 xia4 wu3 si4 dian3 ban4 zai4 wo3 jia1 jian4
d56.27.en: Excellent! See you at 4:30 Saturday at my house.

d57.2.speaker: B
d57.2.pinyin: Qǐng wèn gāo dà zhōng zài bù zài?
d57.2.pinyinNumbered: qing3 wen4 gao1 da4 zhong1 zai4 bu4 zai4
d57.2.en: May I speak to Dazhong Gao?

d57.3.speaker: A
d57.3.zh: 请等一下，我去看一下他在不在家……大中，电话。
d57.3.pinyin: Qǐng děng yī xià, wǒ qù kàn yī xià tā zài bù zài jiā…… dà zhōng, diàn huà.

d57.3.en: Please wait for a moment. I will go take a look (to see) if he is home …. Dazhong, phonecall.

d57.5.speaker: A
d57.5.zh: 我没有问，但是我想是张友生。
d57.5.en: I didn’t ask, but I think it was
d57.5.why: 友 is not a word in the checked lists

d57.6.speaker: C
d57.6.zh: 喂，我是高大中，你是哪位？
d57.6.pinyin: Wèi, wǒ shì gāo dà zhōng, nǐ shì nǎ wèi?
d57.6.pinyinNumbered: wei4 wo3 shi4 gao1 da4 zhong1 ni3 shi4 na3 wei4
d57.6.en: Hello, this is Dazhong Gao. Who is speaking?

d57.7.speaker: B
d57.7.why: 友 is not a word in the checked lists

d57.8.speaker: C
d57.8.en: Ah! Little Zhang, how are you? What’s up? (=Anything specific?)
d57.8.why: 啊 has more than one reading (a1, a2, a3, a4, a5)

d57.9.speaker: B
d57.9.zh: 没有事，我女朋友要我问你觉得李小姐怎么样？
d57.9.en: Nothing specific. My girlfriend wanted me to ask you what you thought of
d57.9.why: it can be split into words in two ways that read differently

d57.10.speaker: C
d57.10.zh: 我觉得她很漂亮，我很喜欢她。
d57.10.pinyin: Wǒ jué de tā hěn piào liang, wǒ hěn xǐ huan tā.
d57.10.pinyinNumbered: wo3 jue2 de5 ta1 hen3 piao4 liang5 wo3 hen3 xi3 huan5 ta1
d57.10.en: I thought she was pretty. I liked her very much.

d57.11.speaker: B
d57.11.zh: 那你为什么还没有给她打电话？我们给你们介绍以后，你没有给她打电话，所以我女朋友很不高兴。
d57.11.en: Then how come (= why) you haven’t called her? After we introduced you (plural), you did not call her, so my girlfriend was unhappy.
d57.11.why: 还 has more than one reading (hai2, huan2)

d57.12.speaker: C
d57.12.zh: 我这个星期太忙了，没有空。下个星期有两个中文考试。
d57.12.en: I am too busy this week, and I don’t have any free time. I have two Chinese tests next week.
d57.12.why: 空 has more than one reading (kong1, kong4)

d57.13.speaker: B
d57.13.zh: 李小姐的中文很好，她在家跟她爸妈说中文，我想她可以帮你准备考试。
d57.13.en: Miss Li’s Chinese is good. She speaks Chinese with her parents at home. I think she can help you prepare for the tests.
d57.13.why: 李 is not a word in the checked lists

d57.14.speaker: C
d57.14.zh: 是吗？太好了！她家电话是几号？
d57.14.en: Is that so? Excellent! What’s her home phone number?
d57.14.why: it can be split into words in two ways that read differently

d57.15.speaker: B
d57.15.zh: 我找一下，啊！在这儿。她的电话是四五八二六九七。要是方便，你可不可以今天给她打？
d57.15.en: I’ll look for it real quick. Ah! It’s here. …Her phone # is 458-2697. If it is not too much trouble (= “if it is convenient”), can you call her today?
d57.15.why: 啊 has more than one reading (a1, a2, a3, a4, a5)

d57.16.speaker: C
d57.16.zh: 好，谢谢！我现在就给她打一个电话，请她跟我去喝一杯咖啡。
d57.16.pinyin: Hǎo, xiè xie! Wǒ xiàn zài jiù gěi tā dǎ yī gè diàn huà, qǐng tā gēn wǒ qù hē yī bēi kā fēi.
d57.16.pinyinNumbered: hao3 xie4 xie5 wo3 xian4 zai4 jiu4 gei3 ta1 da3 yi1 ge4 dian4 hua4 qing3 ta1 gen1 wo3 qu4 he1 yi1 bei1 ka1 fei1
d57.16.en: OK, thanks! I will call her right now and invite her to go have a cup of coffee with me.

d57.17.speaker: A
d57.17.zh: 大中，我得给一个朋友打电话。
d57.17.en: Dazhong, I have to call a friend.
d57.17.why: 得 has more than one reading (de2, de5, dei3)

d57.18.speaker: C
d57.18.zh: 对不起，我姐姐要用电话。
d57.18.pinyin: Duì bu qǐ, wǒ jiě jie yào yòng diàn huà.
d57.18.pinyinNumbered: dui4 bu5 qi3 wo3 jie3 jie5 yao4 yong4 dian4 hua4
d57.18.en: Sorry, my (older) sister wants to use the phone.

d58.1.speaker: A
d58.1.zh: 昨天我在小张家认识了一个漂亮的女孩。她说她认识你。
d58.1.en: Yesterday I met a pretty girl at Little Zhang’s house. She said she knew you.
d58.1.why: 昨 is not a word in the checked lists

d58.2.speaker: B
d58.2.pinyin: Shì ma? Tā jiào shén me míng zi?
d58.2.pinyinNumbered: shi4 ma5 ta1 jiao4 shen2 me5 ming2 zi5
d58.2.en: Is that so? What’s her name?

d58.3.speaker: A
d58.3.zh: 她说她姓高，可是她没有跟我说她的名字，我也没有问。
d58.3.pinyin: Tā shuō tā xìng gāo, kě shì tā méi yǒu gēn wǒ shuō tā de míng zi, wǒ yě méi yǒu wèn.
d58.3.pinyinNumbered: ta1 shuo1 ta1 xing4 gao1 ke3 shi4 ta1 mei2 you3 gen1 wo3 shuo1 ta1 de5 ming2 zi5 wo3 ye3 mei2 you3 wen4
d58.3.en: She said her last name is Gao, but she did not tell me her name, and I did not ask, either.

d58.4.speaker: B
d58.4.pinyin: Duì! Wǒ rèn shi yī gè gāo xiǎo jie.
d58.4.pinyinNumbered: dui4 wo3 ren4 shi5 yi1 ge4 gao1 xiao3 jie5

d58.5.speaker: A
d58.5.zh: 太好了！她的电话是几号？
d58.5.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Tā de diàn huà shì jǐ hào?
d58.5.pinyinNumbered: tai4 hao3 le5 ta1 de5 dian4 hua4 shi4 ji3 hao4

alts.zh: 太好了！她的电话几号？
alts.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Tā de diàn huà jǐ hào?
alts.pinyinNumbered: tai4 hao3 le5 ta1 de5 dian4 hua4 ji3 hao4

d58.6.speaker: B
d58.6.pinyin: Nǐ wèn zhè gè zuò shén me?
d58.6.pinyinNumbered: ni3 wen4 zhe4 ge4 zuo4 shen2 me5
d58.6.en: Why (for what purpose) did you ask this?

d58.7.speaker: A
d58.7.zh: 因为我想给她打电话(，)请她去看电影。
d58.7.en: Because I wanted to call her, and invite her to a movie.

d58.8.speaker: B
d58.8.en: Oh, in this case, I will have to think about it for a bit.
d58.8.why: 得 has more than one reading (de2, de5, dei3)

d58.9.speaker: A
d58.9.en: What is there to think? (= Think about what?)

d58.10.speaker: B
d58.10.zh: 她是小李的女朋友，我不要小李不高兴。
d58.10.en: She is Little Li’s girlfriend. I don’t want Little Li to be unhappy.
d58.10.why: 李 is not a word in the checked lists

d58.11.speaker: A
d58.11.zh: 那你別跟小李说，我也不跟他说。
d58.11.en: Then don’t tell Little Li, and I won’t tell him, either.

d59.1.speaker: A
d59.1.zh: 你跟你女朋友的家人见面了吗？
d59.1.pinyin: Nǐ gēn nǐ nǚ péng you de jiā rén jiàn miàn le ma?
d59.1.pinyinNumbered: ni3 gen1 ni3 nü3 peng2 you5 de5 jia1 ren2 jian4 mian4 le5 ma5
d59.1.en: Have you met with your girlfriend’s family?

d59.2.speaker: B
d59.2.zh: 还没有。我下个星期五才要跟他们见面。
d59.2.en: Not yet. I won’t meet them until next
d59.2.why: 还 has more than one reading (hai2, huan2)

d59.3.speaker: A
d59.3.pinyin: Nǐ men yào zài nǎr jiàn miàn?
d59.3.pinyinNumbered: ni3 men5 yao4 zai4 na3 r5 jian4 mian4
d59.3.en: Where are you (plural, meaning you and her parents) to meet?

d59.4.speaker: B
d59.4.zh: 我下午六点要到他们家去，我女朋友给我们介绍了以后，我们要一起到一家饭馆去吃饭。她爸爸的弟弟上星期开了一家饭馆，我想我们要去这家饭馆吃吧！
d59.4.en: I am going to their house (complement of direction) at 6:00 in the afternoon. After my girlfriend introduces us, we are going together to a restaurant (complement of direction) to have a meal. Her uncle opened a restaurant last week. I (strongly) think we must be going to this restaurant to eat.
d59.4.why: it can be split into words in two ways that read differently

d59.5.speaker: A
d59.5.zh: 他们是中国人，这是一家中国饭馆吧！
d59.5.pinyin: Tā men shì zhōng guó rén, zhè shì yī jiā zhōng guó fàn guǎn ba!
d59.5.pinyinNumbered: ta1 men5 shi4 zhong1 guo2 ren2 zhe4 shi4 yi1 jia1 zhong1 guo2 fan4 guan3 ba5
d59.5.en: They are Chinese. This must be a Chinese restaurant, isn’t it?

d59.6.speaker: B
d59.6.zh: 对！吃了饭，我们要回他们家去喝咖啡。
d59.6.pinyin: Duì! Chī le fàn, wǒ men yào huí tā men jiā qù hē kā fēi.
d59.6.pinyinNumbered: dui4 chi1 le5 fan4 wo3 men5 yao4 hui2 ta1 men5 jia1 qu4 he1 ka1 fei1
d59.6.en: That’s correct! After dinner, we are going back to her house (complement of direction) for coffee.

d59.7.speaker: A
d59.7.pinyin: Nǐ xiàn zài hěn gāo xìng ba!
d59.7.pinyinNumbered: ni3 xian4 zai4 hen3 gao1 xing4 ba5
d59.7.en: You must be happy now, aren’t you?

d59.8.speaker: B
d59.8.zh: 对！你可以不可以帮我练习一下我那天要跟她爸妈说什么？
d59.8.pinyin: Duì! Nǐ kě yǐ bù kě yǐ bāng wǒ liàn xí yī xià wǒ nà tiān yào gēn tā bà mā shuō shén me?
d59.8.pinyinNumbered: dui4 ni3 ke3 yi3 bu4 ke3 yi3 bang1 wo3 lian4 xi2 yi1 xia4 wo3 na4 tian1 yao4 gen1 ta1 ba4 ma1 shuo1 shen2 me5
d59.8.en: That’s correct! Could you help me practice a little bit what I will say to her parents that day?

alts.zh: 对！你可不可以帮我练习一下我那天要跟她爸妈说什么？
alts.pinyin: Duì! Nǐ kě bù kě yǐ bāng wǒ liàn xí yī xià wǒ nà tiān yào gēn tā bà mā shuō shén me?
alts.pinyinNumbered: dui4 ni3 ke3 bu4 ke3 yi3 bang1 wo3 lian4 xi2 yi1 xia4 wo3 na4 tian1 yao4 gen1 ta1 ba4 ma1 shuo1 shen2 me5

d59.9.speaker: A
d59.9.zh: 好啊！你想跟他们说什么？
d59.9.en: (Enthusiastically)Sure! What would you like to say to them?
d59.9.why: 啊 has more than one reading (a1, a2, a3, a4, a5)

d59.10.speaker: B
d59.10.zh: 要是你是我，你要说什么？
d59.10.pinyin: Yào shi nǐ shì wǒ, nǐ yào shuō shén me?
d59.10.pinyinNumbered: yao4 shi5 ni3 shi4 wo3 ni3 yao4 shuo1 shen2 me5
d59.10.en: If you were I, what would you say?

d59.11.speaker: A
d59.11.zh: 你可以説“我很高兴认识你们”。
d59.11.en: You can say “I am pleased to make your acquaintance.”

d59.12.speaker: B
d59.12.zh: 好！我回家去练习一下。谢谢！
d59.12.pinyin: Hǎo! Wǒ huí jiā qù liàn xí yī xià. Xiè xie!
d59.12.pinyinNumbered: hao3 wo3 hui2 jia1 qu4 lian4 xi2 yi1 xia4 xie4 xie5
d59.12.en: OK! I will go home (complement of direction) to practice. Thanks!

d59.13.speaker: A
d59.13.zh: 別客氣。我也想问你一个问题。
d59.13.en: You are welcome. I also wanted to ask you a question.

d59.14.speaker: B
d59.14.en: Go ahead! （= Why don’t you ask!）

d59.15.speaker: A
d59.15.zh: 你女朋友有一个漂亮的妹妹，你可以不可以给我介绍她妹妹？
d59.15.pinyin: Nǐ nǚ péng you yǒu yī gè piào liang de mèi mei, nǐ kě yǐ bù kě yǐ gěi wǒ jiè shào tā mèi mei?
d59.15.pinyinNumbered: ni3 nü3 peng2 you5 you3 yi1 ge4 piao4 liang5 de5 mei4 mei5 ni3 ke3 yi3 bu4 ke3 yi3 gei3 wo3 jie4 shao4 ta1 mei4 mei5
d59.15.en: Your girlfriend has a pretty (younger) sister. Can you introduce her sister to me?

alts.zh: 你女朋友有一个漂亮的妹妹，你可不可以给我介绍她妹妹？
alts.pinyin: Nǐ nǚ péng you yǒu yī gè piào liang de mèi mei, nǐ kě bù kě yǐ gěi wǒ jiè shào tā mèi mei?
alts.pinyinNumbered: ni3 nü3 peng2 you5 you3 yi1 ge4 piao4 liang5 de5 mei4 mei5 ni3 ke3 bu4 ke3 yi3 gei3 wo3 jie4 shao4 ta1 mei4 mei5

d59.16.speaker: B
d59.16.zh: 对不起，不行，因为她还太小了，她爸爸说她还不可以有男朋友。
d59.16.en: Sorry, I cannot because she is still too young. Her dad says that she cannot have a boyfriend yet.
d59.16.why: 还 has more than one reading (hai2, huan2)

d60.1.speaker: 小王的妈妈
d60.1.zh: 李老师，请问我儿子学中文学得怎么样？
d60.1.en: Teacher Li, may I please ask how well my son learns Chinese? (This means “how is he doing in learning Chinese?”)
d60.1.why: 李 is not a word in the checked lists

d60.2.speaker: 李老师
d60.2.zh: 他写字写得很漂亮，可是说话说得太慢了。
d60.2.en: His handwriting is pretty (= writes characters pretty), but he speaks too slowly.
d60.2.why: 得 has more than one reading (de2, de5, dei3)

d60.3.speaker: 王太太
d60.3.zh: 好，他爸爸是中国人，我要他以后常跟他爸爸说中文。
d60.3.pinyin: Hǎo, tā bà ba shì zhōng guó rén, wǒ yào tā yǐ hòu cháng gēn tā bà ba shuō zhōng wén.
d60.3.pinyinNumbered: hao3 ta1 ba4 ba5 shi4 zhong1 guo2 ren2 wo3 yao4 ta1 yi3 hou4 chang2 gen1 ta1 ba4 ba5 shuo1 zhong1 wen2
d60.3.en: OK, his dad is Chinese. I will demand (= want) him to often speak Chinese with his dad from now on.

d60.4.speaker: 李老师
d60.4.zh: 那太好了！我想小王以后中文可以说得很好。
d60.4.en: That would be great! I think that in the future, Little Wang can speak Chinese well.
d60.4.why: 得 has more than one reading (de2, de5, dei3)

d60.5.speaker: 王太太
d60.5.zh: 可是他爸爸好久没有说中文，所以他的中文也说得也不太好。
d60.5.en: But his dad has not been speaking Chinese in a long time. So he does not speak Chinese too well, either.
d60.5.why: 得 has more than one reading (de2, de5, dei3)

d60.6.speaker: 李老师
d60.6.zh: 那小王可以找一个中国人跟他练习。
d60.6.pinyin: Nà xiǎo wáng kě yǐ zhǎo yī gè zhōng guó rén gēn tā liàn xí.
d60.6.pinyinNumbered: na4 xiao3 wang2 ke3 yi3 zhao3 yi1 ge4 zhong1 guo2 ren2 gen1 ta1 lian4 xi2
d60.6.en: Then Xiao Wang can look for a Chinese to practice with him.

d60.7.speaker: 王太太
d60.7.zh: 我们不认识别的中国人。您可以不可给我们介绍几个？
d60.7.pinyin: Wǒ men bù rèn shi bié de zhōng guó rén. Nín kě yǐ bù kě gěi wǒ men jiè shào jǐ gè?
d60.7.pinyinNumbered: wo3 men5 bu4 ren4 shi5 bie2 de5 zhong1 guo2 ren2 nin2 ke3 yi3 bu4 ke3 gei3 wo3 men5 jie4 shao4 ji3 ge4
d60.7.en: We don’t know any other Chinese. Can you introduce a few to us?

d60.8.speaker: 李老师
d60.8.zh: 我的中国朋友中文都说得太快了，因为他们不懂怎么跟外国人说话。
d60.8.en: All my Chinese friends speak Chinese too fast because they don’t understand how to talk with foreigners.

d70.15.speaker: 爸
d70.15.zh: 下个月我给你买一个新电脑。

d70.15.pinyinNumbered: xia4 ge4 yue4 wo3 gei3 ni3 mai3 yi1 ge4 xin1 dian4 nao3
d70.15.en: Next month, I will buy a new computer for you.

d70.16.zh: 真的吗？太好了！爸爸，我们可不可以吃了饭就去看电脑？
d70.16.pinyin: Zhēn de ma? Tài hǎo le! Bà ba, wǒ men kě bù kě yǐ chī le fàn jiù qù kàn diàn nǎo?

d70.16.en: Really? Great! Dad, can we go look at computers right after dinner?

d70.17.speaker: 爸
d70.17.zh: 好啊！可是我下个月才可以给你买，因为我那时候才有钱。
d70.17.en: Sure (enthusiastically)! But I won’t be able to buy one for you until next month because I won’t have the money until then.
d70.17.why: 啊 has more than one reading (a1, a2, a3, a4, a5)

d70.18.speaker: 中
d70.18.zh: 好！我现在的电脑还可以。
d70.18.en: OK! My current computer is still fine (meaning average, so-so).
d70.18.why: 还 has more than one reading (hai2, huan2)

d70.19.speaker: 爸
d70.19.zh: 去问你妈妈，吃了饭想不想跟我们一起去看电脑。我们看了电脑以后，我请你们两个去吃冰淇淋。
d70.19.en: Go ask you mom if she would like to go with us to look at computers after dinner. After we have looked at the computers, I will treat the two of you to ice cream.
d70.19.why: 淇 is not a word in the checked lists

d70.20.speaker: 妈
d70.20.zh: 你们两个在说什么？来吃饭。
d70.20.pinyin: Nǐ men liǎng gè zài shuō shén me? Lái chī fàn.
d70.20.pinyinNumbered: ni3 men5 liang3 ge4 zai4 shuo1 shen2 me5 lai2 chi1 fan4
